foundations.color.description: Choose a color by its role (action, content, surface or status), never by how it looks: the same role keeps its meaning when the theme changes.
foundations.color.group.action.descripti: What invites a click, the ring that shows where keyboard focus is, and the disabled counterpart.
foundations.color.group.action.title: Action
foundations.color.group.content.descript: Text and links on a surface.
foundations.color.group.content.title: Content
foundations.color.group.navigation.descr: The dark surface of the navigation and of tooltips, with its text.
foundations.color.group.navigation.title: Navigation
foundations.color.group.status.descripti: Information, success, warning and error. Each one pairs a text color with a background: read the result in the contrast table.
foundations.color.group.status.title: Status
foundations.color.group.surface.descript: The page, the panels on it, the lines that separate them, the track behind progress and the layer behind a dialog.
foundations.color.group.surface.title: Surface
foundations.color.title: Color with meaning
foundations.contrast.caption.nonText: {count, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} of non-text colors in the {theme, select, dark {dark} other {light}} theme. They need {threshold, number}:1.
foundations.contrast.caption.text: {count, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} of text on its background in the {theme, select, dark {dark} other {light}} theme. AA needs {aa, number}:1 and AAA needs {aaa, number}:1.
foundations.contrast.description: The ratio of every pair of colors that is painted together, measured on the values above. Text is graded AA and AAA; the parts of a control and graphics have a single threshold.
foundations.contrast.title: Measured contrast
foundations.lead: Color, type and space: the decisions that keep every interface coherent. Everything below is read from the tokens of the package, so it is always what ships.
foundations.spacing.description: A shared scale to separate controls, group content and set a rhythm. Each bar is as wide as its token.
foundations.spacing.title: Spacing
foundations.theme: Values shown for the {theme, select, dark {dark} other {light}} theme.
foundations.type.description: One family orders information by size, weight and line height. Each style is a single token.
foundations.type.family: Every style uses the family token {token}: {value}.
foundations.type.sample: A clear hierarchy lets people understand and move on.
foundations.type.style.body: Body text: a paragraph, a table cell, a field value.
foundations.type.style.caption: Captions and supporting information.
foundations.type.style.label: Labels of fields and controls.
foundations.type.style.section: Section headings and the lead of a page.
foundations.type.style.strong: Emphasis inside body text, and small headings.
foundations.type.style.title: Page title.
foundations.type.title: Type hierarchy
